budget_items.what_was_recorded: The attached presentation prints a project total for the proposed scope of $13,735,372.

The presentation estimates a debt-exclusion tax impact of about $0.46 per thousand of assessed value, or $231 a year for an average single-family home assessed at $504,937, on an 18-year amortization.
budget_items.quote: roughly $0.46 per thousand of a home assessed value.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The presentation gives a reduced funding scope (Phase 1/2B) total cost of $6,460,691, with a tax impact of $0.22 per thousand, or about $111 a year on average.
The construction cost table prints a 5% contingency on hard costs of $613,689.
The presentation totals the new annual maintenance expense for the project at $53,300.
The presentation totals current annual park maintenance at $23,425.00 (budget estimates, not dedicated to Marshall Park).
The presentation lists new snow shoveling at about $500 per storm.
The presentation says the project was selected for a $1m grant in 2024 but did not meet requirements in time.
